'''Fush Hunt Down up for review''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fush]]
* '''Published:''' 17 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 HD Fush DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Sooner or later I had to make my first HD deck, and this is it. It should be a decent start, but I could use some advice to tune it right. Feel free to provide your comments. Thanks!

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

How well would this deck work as it is now? I know the dueling side is probably too weak. When the new Bad Feeling Have I (V) comes out, I'll pack Deep Hatred, and ditch a couple of Vaders. Preferrably, I'll have two Lord Vaders. And I'll probably have to get a They Will Be Now Match ForYou to let Maul duel.

Do the effects in here make any sense? The Twi'lek's will let me pull them, but I'm not convinced that Crush The Rebellion is worth the slot. And is my space package OK?

Which other points do you see? At least, the beatdown potential in here should be pretty good.
